description: This file defines a React component named ShelfCarousel, which displays a carousel of book items, including individual ShelfBook components and an option to add new books. It manages filtering of books based on a search text and renders a limited number of books.

classes.name: ShelfCarousel
classes.description: React component class that renders a scrollable shelf of books with filter functionality.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component state with provided props and sets searchText.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Filters books if searchText is not empty after component mounts.

methods.name: filterBooks
methods.description: Returns a list of books filtered by the searchText string.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the shelf container with book items and controls.

methods.name: renderShelfBook
methods.description: Creates and returns an array of React elements for displaying books, limited to six items.
